title: Preflight: Adaptive Preflight Questionnaire and Priority Estimator for Enterprise Hosted API Requests
creator: Sofia Nguyen
description: Implement an adaptive preflight questionnaire and rule-based priority estimator to triage incoming enterprise feature requests for the Hosted API (chat, streaming, function/tool calling, structured outputs). The goal is to reduce human review time, surface SLA/security flags earlier, and route requests into appropriate intake lanes (self-serve, growth/SE, enterprise concierge). The system will capture key signals (expected throughput, latency requirement, data residency, structured output needs, tool-calling complexity) and produce a score plus recommended next action. Initial phase: rule-based engine with manual override and analytics; Phase 2: lightweight ML scorer trained on historical triage outcomes.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Questionnaire UI accessible from intake form and via emailed intake link; captures required signals for chat/streaming/tool-calls/structured outputs.
A2: Priority estimator returns a numeric score (0-100) and a recommended intake lane (self-serve, growth, enterprise-concierge) for 95% of submissions.
A3: Flagging: requests that require security_review or Private deployment are auto-marked for enterprise-concierge with explicit rationale.
A4: Triage dashboard shows per-day distribution of scores and top signal contributors; product and SEs can filter by tenant and region.
A5: Manual override flow documented and accessible; overrides logged with rationale and reviewer name.
A6: No PII is persisted in the questionnaire answers; sensitive fields are stored only as categorical signals (e.g., "has_sensitive_data": yes/no).
success_metrics: Reduce average manual triage time per request from 28m to <=10m within 8 weeks of rollout
Auto-route >= 60% of incoming enterprise Hosted API requests to correct intake lane in initial rollout
Surface security/compliance flags at intake for >95% of requests that later require a security review
decisions: Scope: Phase 1 will be rule-based; ML scorer deferred until we have 1k+ labeled triage outcomes
Privacy: store only categorical/sparse signals for sensitive items; free-text examples truncated before storage
Rollout: start with invited enterprise beta tenants and internal SE intake, then expand to all customers after 4 weeks
Fallback: if questionnaire incomplete or inconsistent, route to "enterprise-concierge" as conservative default
Telemetry: include top-3 contributing signals for each score to aid auditing and explainability
